{{WorldTableTennisChampionshipsEvents|year=2017}}
{{main|2017 World Table Tennis Championships}}

The '''2017 World Table Tennis Championships mixed doubles''' was the 54th edition of the mixed doubles championship.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.allabouttabletennis.com/world-table-tennis-championships-medal-winners.html|title=List of Winners|publisher=All About Table Tennis}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/museum/WorldChResultsXD.pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120609224957/http://www.ittf.com/museum/WorldChResultsXD.pdf|url-status=dead|archive-date=2012-06-09|title=Mixed doubles results|publisher=International Table Tennis Federation}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://sports123.com/tte/index.html|title=Table Tennis World Championship medal winners|publisher=Sports123}}</ref>

[[Xu Xin (table tennis)|Xu Xin]] and [[Yang Ha-eun]] were the defending champions but Xu did not compete this year.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.old.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_mix_wttc_web.asp?Gender=M&Tour_ID=2705&Mix=1 |title=Entry list |website= |access-date=2017-05-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170512070618/http://www.old.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_mix_wttc_web.asp?Gender=M&Tour_ID=2705&Mix=1 |archive-date=2017-05-12 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

[[Maharu Yoshimura]] and [[Kasumi Ishikawa]] won the title after defeating [[Chen Chien-an]] and [[Cheng I-ching]] 8–11, 8–11, 11–8, 10–12, 11–4, 11–9, 11–5.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/2017/06/03/press-release-japan-claims-first-ittf-world-championships-gold-48-years/|title=Press Release: Japan Claims First ITTF World Championships Mixed Doubles Gold in 48 Years|date=3 June 2017|work=ittf.com}}</ref>

==Seeds==
Matches were best of 5 games in qualification and best of 7 games in the 64-player sized main draw.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.old.ittf.com/World_Events/2017WTTC/Playing_system_WTTC2017.pdf |title=Playing system |access-date=2017-05-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170329113132/http://www.old.ittf.com/World_Events/2017WTTC/Playing_system_WTTC2017.pdf |archive-date=2017-03-29 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>[http://d3mjm6zw6cr45s.cloudfront.net/2016/11/2017_WTTC_XD.pdf Seeds]{{Dead link|date=January 2022 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>
